scope: All 42 proposal bodies and 3 manifests, the safety replacement, fixed answers/DL-043/DL-035, D3 discovery details, and selected current canonical owner passages. Read-only canonical/proposal review; no authorship.
boundary: This proposal review is not final assembled-diff certification, runtime evidence, schema admission, or a governance gate result. Applied-variant manifest requested from parent; only changed passages and binding changes require final review.

findings.title: Require reconciliation before retry, not mandatory retry after reconciliation
findings.exact_text: after-reconciliation retry is mandatory for effect_unknown.
findings.reason: This literally requires a retry even when reconciliation proves the original effect already applied. It conflicts with JJI-003/SCS-003 and the timeout-after-success anti-duplication rule in SCS-016. Other proposal units generally preserve the correct conditional retry rule.
findings.required_narrow_repair: Replace the clause with reconciliation mandatory before any retry; return the original confirmed result when already applied, allow retry only for proven unapplied effects under current fences and the preserved idempotency identity, and leave unresolved effects blocked.

non_actionable_observations.text: F3-556 uses the presentation shorthand that review marks move. SCS-020 explicitly preserves original evidence and permits only derived correspondence. Preserve the native-owner dependency in assembly; the full contract does not permit hosted approval transfer.

Storage physical rebuild mechanics are read within the addendum's explicit consumption of Jujutsu and Source Control. Native rebuild execution must remain through the internal adapter owner; Storage custody is not a second native service. A short clarification would improve readability but the proposal grants no bypass.

The chosen policy specifies nearest existing endings without inventing a new setting or whole-file normalization. No-boundary and equidistant implementation cases still require deterministic owner qualification; they do not reopen the user decision.

decision_verdicts.name: Named history markers
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add named markers on existing checkpoints
decision_verdicts.rationale: Names annotate existing checkpoint/operation identities; duplicate labels and missing targets cannot retarget recovery.

decision_verdicts.name: Grouped history actions
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Group display and provide verified group undo
decision_verdicts.rationale: Ordered applied members and partial outcomes support separately verified group undo without an atomic-batch claim.

decision_verdicts.name: Recent actions and redo
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add recent actions and supported redo
decision_verdicts.rationale: Recent navigation is bounded; redo requires an exact qualified relation and rejects changed or divergent native state.

decision_verdicts.name: Filter operation history
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add simple action and time filters
decision_verdicts.rationale: Simple action/time filtering preserves unknown/external operations, time basis, omissions and pagination; no operation query language added.

decision_verdicts.name: Readable operation descriptions
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add structured descriptions from existing receipts
decision_verdicts.rationale: Descriptions derive from existing sanitized receipts and never create operations or become identity/idempotency.

decision_verdicts.name: History storage maintenance
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Diagnose growth and offer explicit maintenance
decision_verdicts.rationale: Diagnostics and explicit authorized maintenance preserve retained closure and capture/GC fences; automatic pruning is excluded.

decision_verdicts.name: Reverse one selected operation
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a separately labeled reverse-selected-operation action
decision_verdicts.rationale: Reverse-selected-operation binds one exact historic operation against current state, rejects unsupported root/merge targets and remains distinct from sequential undo.

decision_verdicts.name: Preview a rewrite before applying it
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add an explicitly managed rewrite preview and apply workflow
decision_verdicts.rationale: Rewrite preview is an effectful managed lifecycle with isolation, custody, cleanup and separately revalidated application; it is neither read-only dry run nor backup alignment.

decision_verdicts.name: Browse an earlier repository state
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a clearly labeled earlier-state browsing mode
decision_verdicts.rationale: Earlier-state browsing coordinates graph/tree/content/bookmarks at one historical operation and cannot restore or substitute current objects.

decision_verdicts.name: Export operation diagnostics
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add explicit sanitized export
decision_verdicts.rationale: Explicit sanitized export creates an authorized artifact with bounded reviewed scope, destination and receipt; it does not upload or execute.

decision_verdicts.name: View source-control commands
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add an optional technical log view
decision_verdicts.rationale: Optional bounded command log consumes redacted exact receipts; stdout and exit status never become authority.

decision_verdicts.name: Combine divergent versions
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add guided convergence when supported
decision_verdicts.rationale: Guided convergence binds exact divergent commits of one change and makes heuristic ambiguity and conflicts explicit.

decision_verdicts.name: Duplicate a change
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a duplicate action
decision_verdicts.rationale: Duplication creates independent change identity from exact source and destination parents, with descendant effects qualified.

decision_verdicts.name: Create a merge change
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a merge action
decision_verdicts.rationale: Merge creation preserves selected parent identities, ordering and conflict consequences without a hidden Git alias.

decision_verdicts.name: Absorb edits into earlier changes
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add absorption with preview
decision_verdicts.rationale: Absorption fixes dirty snapshot, per-hunk allocations and affected descendants before approval; ambiguous remainder stays visible.

decision_verdicts.name: Back out a change
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a back-out action
decision_verdicts.rationale: Back-out creates a compensating source change preserving intervening history; it is distinct from operation recovery.

decision_verdicts.name: Compare versions of a change
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a version-to-version comparison
decision_verdicts.rationale: Version comparison binds immutable endpoints and parent normalization, with explicit unsupported or missing baselines.

decision_verdicts.name: Change evolution
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a focused evolution view
decision_verdicts.rationale: Focused evolution follows bounded predecessor lineage and preserves divergence, abandonment and retention gaps.

decision_verdicts.name: Edit history by dragging
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add previewed drag actions and keyboard equivalents
decision_verdicts.rationale: Drag and keyboard produce the same exact previewed native intent, preserving multiselection, insert/move and descendant semantics.

decision_verdicts.name: Scriptable partial changes
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a structured hunk selection interface
decision_verdicts.rationale: Structured hunk input shares native routes, exact snapshots and occurrence identities; duplicate text, truncation and unsupported file types cannot widen selection.

decision_verdicts.name: Read-only repositories
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a supported read-only browsing mode
decision_verdicts.rationale: Qualified physically read-only browsing prohibits original-store mutation and discloses unsupported or incomplete paths.

decision_verdicts.name: Adopt existing workspaces
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add an explicit adoption and repair flow
decision_verdicts.rationale: Explicit adoption/repair preserves native identity, previews mapping and individual effects, and exposes partial or quarantined state.

decision_verdicts.name: Hide inactive workspaces
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add hide and unhide
decision_verdicts.rationale: Hide/unhide is idempotent presentation metadata on stable workspace identity; it does not remove data or release authority.

decision_verdicts.name: Very large repository backends
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Defer specialized storage
decision_verdicts.rationale: Deferred specialized storage has no PlanUnit or new backend/library.

decision_verdicts.name: Prioritize graph lanes
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add explicit lane priorities
decision_verdicts.rationale: Native lane priorities intersect visible bounded graph identity and preserve stable layout/currentness.

decision_verdicts.name: Help with history queries
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add native query assistance
decision_verdicts.rationale: Version-qualified native query help remains bounded and distinct from query execution and operation-query language.

decision_verdicts.name: Keep comparison context visible
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add pinned comparison and selected-change details
decision_verdicts.rationale: Pins bind immutable comparison endpoints and selected details; refresh cannot silently retarget or invent staging.

decision_verdicts.name: Line attribution and file history
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add bounded attribution and file history
decision_verdicts.rationale: Bounded attribution and file history carry exact revision/path/range provenance and disclose rename and performance limitations.

decision_verdicts.name: Review marks that survive edits
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add conservative matching with stale markers
decision_verdicts.rationale: Conservative matching preserves original immutable review evidence, adds derived unambiguous correspondence, and exposes stale/orphaned marks without moving hosted approval.

decision_verdicts.name: Review a workspace with AI
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Use existing chat review workflows
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined specialized AI workspace-review workflow has no PlanUnit; existing chat review remains.

decision_verdicts.name: New line endings in mixed-ending text
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Use the nearest existing line ending; preserve existing endings on ordinary Save.
decision_verdicts.rationale: Nearest-existing behavior is a required new-boundary policy; ordinary Save preserves surviving CRLF/LF/CR and optional paste normalization remains scoped.

decision_verdicts.name: Use an external diff or merge editor
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Keep resolution inside Puppet Master
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined external diff/merge editor has no PlanUnit; in-PM resolution remains unchanged.

decision_verdicts.name: Publish unresolved conflicts
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Block by default; add an advanced path only for qualified compatible targets.
decision_verdicts.rationale: Default blocking and exact qualified-compatible-target condition are explicit acceptance criteria, with separate local conflict and publication truth.

decision_verdicts.name: Resolve a conflicted bookmark
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a guided picker only if it clarifies rather than hides the target states.
decision_verdicts.rationale: Picker must display all target alternatives and prove clarity; it uses admitted actions only and blocks stale or unrepresentable selections.

decision_verdicts.name: Publish a stack of reviews
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add one explicitly supported forge workflow at a time.
decision_verdicts.rationale: One supported forge workflow at a time is an admission condition; stack identities, partial publication/review outcomes and per-phase idempotency are preserved.

decision_verdicts.name: Additional review services
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add only for a concrete user workflow and keep local history independent.
decision_verdicts.rationale: Additional service admission requires a concrete workflow with exact provider semantics and preserves independent local history; no provider is silently selected.

decision_verdicts.name: Custom actions around publishing
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Keep publication within existing adapter behavior
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined custom publication actions have no PlanUnit or hook runner.

decision_verdicts.name: How the adapter runs
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Own a separate internal service
decision_verdicts.rationale: PM owns a separate authenticated internal adapter service and engine/diff implementation; existing leases and routes remain authoritative.

decision_verdicts.name: Reuse a diff library
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Keep an independently owned diff implementation
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined library reuse has no PlanUnit; the architecture unit retains the independently owned implementation constraint.

decision_verdicts.name: Connect external IDEs
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Keep source-control interaction in Puppet Master
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined external IDE connectivity has no PlanUnit or new endpoint.

decision_verdicts.name: Shared source-control service
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Use existing owner services only
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined shared source-control service has no PlanUnit; existing internal owner-service routing remains.

decision_verdicts.name: Connect other agent tools
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Keep existing internal agent routes
decision_verdicts.rationale: Declined external-agent/MCP interface has no PlanUnit or alternate runtime route.

decision_verdicts.name: Store or rebuild history indexes
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Prefer rebuilding correctness-critical indexes in the isolated drill; keep captured indexes only as an optional speed aid.
decision_verdicts.rationale: Isolated drill must rebuild correctness-critical indexes and prove native closure without captured caches; optional speed-aid capture is narrow and scope-authorized.

decision_verdicts.name: Complete missing repository data
decision_verdicts.verbatim_answer: Add a separately authorized completion workflow
decision_verdicts.rationale: Missing-data completion is separately authorized transport, preserves exact scope and credentials, recaptures and verifies closure, and cannot activate restore or relabel old snapshots.
